message.content:
洛杉磯（Pacific Time）與柏林（Central European Time）的標準時差為 **9 小時**，即柏林時間比洛杉磯時間快 9 小時。

> **注意：**  
> - 在夏令時間（Daylight Saving Time, DST）期間，兩地的時差會因各自 DST 開始/結束日期不同而短暫變化。  
>   - 例如在美國 DST 開始後、歐洲 DST 尚未開始時，差距可能縮短到 8 小時。  
>   - 反之，在歐洲 DST 結束後、仍處於美國 DST 時，差距可能擴大到 10 小時。  
> - 但在大多數情況下，尤其是當兩地同時處於各自的 DST 或同時處於標準時間時，差距保持 9 小時。

The user asks: "洛杉磯和柏林之間的時差是多少？" They want the time difference between Los Angeles and Berlin. We need to provide the answer. Possibly we should use the function to fetch coordinates? But the question is about time difference. We can compute manually: Los Angeles is in Pacific Time Zone (UTC-8 standard, UTC-7 daylight). Berlin is Central European Time (UTC+1 standard, UTC+2 daylight). So difference is 9 hours during standard time (Los Angeles behind Berlin by 9 hours). During daylight saving, difference is 9 hours as well? Let's check: In summer, Los Angeles is UTC-7, Berlin is UTC+2, difference is 9 hours. In winter, Los Angeles is UTC-8, Berlin is UTC+1, difference is 9 hours. So it's always 9 hours difference. But if we consider daylight saving changes at different times, there might be a period where difference is 8 or 10 hours. Actually, daylight saving starts/ends at different dates. For example, in 2023, US DST started on March 12, ended on November 5. Germany DST started on March 26, ended on October 29. So between March 12 and March 26, Los Angeles is on DST (UTC-7) while Berlin is still on standard time (UTC+1), so difference is 8 hours. After March 26, both are on DST, difference remains 9 hours. Then after October 29, Berlin goes back to standard time (UTC+1) while Los Angeles remains on DST until November 5, so difference becomes 10 hours. After November 5, Los Angeles goes back to standard time, difference returns to 9 hours.

Thus the difference varies over the year. The user likely wants a general answer: 9 hours difference. But we could mention the variations due to DST. The user didn't specify a date.
